name: Synthetic Real-Time Scheduling Benchmark
description: This dataset provides a deterministic synthetic benchmark for evaluating adaptive single-processor real-time scheduling policies. It contains 640 reproducible task sets divided into 320 training, 160 validation, and 160 held-out test workloads. The benchmark supports evaluation of Rate Monotonic Scheduling (RMS), Earliest Deadline First (EDF), RMS with bounded Priority Boost, EDF with bounded Priority Boost, and an adaptive two-stage scheduler that selects a policy every 100 ms. The release includes 51,840 labeled training and validation decision states, 207,360 counterfactual policy evaluations, explicit task releases and execution demands, frozen data splits, reference models, validation results, final held-out test results, statistical reports, protocols, source code, and SHA-256 checksums. This is a simulation-generated synthetic benchmark and does not contain hardware measurements or real production traces. The final test results are frozen and must not be used for model tuning.
